artifact: MCR seed row18 endpoint and sampling qualification

primary.title: Assessment of the occurrence of MCR producing Enterobacteriaceae in Swiss and imported poultry meat
primary.identity_status: Full publisher PDF title/authors/printed DOI agree with seed reference; resolver returned404, Crossref title/DOI matched.

collection.unit: different fresh retail poultry meat products
collection.sampling_frame: Retail products mainly collected by consumer protection organisation Gesundheitstipp; probability selection of stores/products not established.
collection.randomisation_caveat: Random within-product portions do not establish random store/product sampling.

endpoints.denominator_unit: sample-associated cultures from fresh poultry meat products
endpoints.event: mcr-1 PCR positive in growth on initial selective medium after enrichment
endpoints.not_equivalent_to: 33 confirmed E. coli isolates or direct-PCR positivity of untreated meat

endpoints.event: pure mcr-1 E. coli culture recovered from a sample
discarded during repeated subculture because of mixed Proteus growth
endpoints.classification: unrecovered positive cultures, not negative samples

detection.classification: culture-enriched molecular screen followed by isolate recovery and characterisation
sequence: mcr-1 PCR on bacteria from initial selective plates
sequence confirmation of the 12 recovered mcr-1 E. coli isolates

inference_limits: No representative national prevalence inferred from product-origin strata.
No transmission direction inferred from shared sequence types.
Sample-level screen and pure-isolate recovery must remain separate endpoints.
No seed counts or pooled totals changed.
